decision: Do not replace the current engine yet.

supported_facts.claim: Adoption requires exact-candidate production-shaped p99 evidence; median-only evidence is insufficient.
Q-17 reduced median latency by 18% on a 50-request sample, but tail latency was not measured.
An earlier build increased p99 by 9%, and its identity relative to Q-17 is unknown.

unknowns.claim: Production-shaped p99 evidence is available for Q-17.
The Q-17 identity matches the exact release candidate.

next_check: Run the exact release candidate under production-shaped load and measure p99.
